articles.title: US to host first Women's Club World Cup in 2028
articles.summary: Arsenal are named as one of the teams to compete at the inaugural Women's Club World Cup, to be hosted in the United States in 2028.

articles.title: Saka injury 'does not look good' - how will Arsenal cope?
articles.summary: Mikel Arteta says the quadriceps injury Arsenal's Bukayo Saka picked up in the Champions League draw with Bayern Munich "does not look good at all".

articles.title: Verstappen criticises 'unacceptable' COTA surface amid concerns over injury
articles.summary: Max Verstappen revealed concerns over the state of his spine as he unleashed a scathing criticism of the "out of control" bumpy track surface at Circuit of The Americas.
